ai_overview.text: Excessive sweating, or hyperhidrosis, is treated in Guntur through specialized dermatology and multi-specialty clinics . Common local options include prescription antiperspirants, oral medications, and advanced clinical procedures like Botox injections available at centers such as Dr. Ragini Skin & Hair Clinic in Pattabhipuram and Aster Ramesh Hospital in Nagarampalem. Instagram · b18skinclinic +5 Common Treatment Options Prescription Antiperspirants: Clinical-strength aluminum chloride formulas applied to dry skin at night. Oral Medications: Anticholinergic drugs to block nerve signals that trigger sweat glands. Botox Injections: FDA-approved injections that temporarily block sweat production in areas like underarms, palms, or feet. Iontophoresis: Passing a mild electrical current through water to temporarily shut down sweat glands.
